arms.sp_in:
korean bubblegum dance, girl group dance pop, toy accordion bounce.

126 BPM, 4/4, key of F major.

A playful, polished female vocal teases every line with a wink.

A toy accordion hook carries the melody over a thin synth pad. The sub bass outlines each root and follows phrases with short slides. Cabasa percussion fills the gaps with quick shakes.

A bouncy kick drum lands four to the floor with jersey-style kick rolls, snappy claps on two and four and open hi-hats on the offbeats.

The arrangement begins on accordion and cabasa, then an instrumental break lets accordion and bass trade phrases.

The mix keeps the lead vocal close, with the sub bass tucked under the kick drum.

Side-chain compression pumps the pad, and playful ear-candy sound effects pop between phrases.

A teasing female group vocal answers each call in call-and-response.

arms.sp_in:
electropop, girl group dance pop, orchestral bells and soaring brass on a night train.

124 BPM, 4/4, key of E major.

Powerful female vocal stays low in the train lines and opens into a high belt on each title.

A rolling sub bass layers pulses under each kick. Orchestral bells trace the hook in ringing runs over strings. A soaring brass section doubles every title line as grand piano holds the chords.

Drum machine programming puts a kick on every beat, claps on two and four, and rolling sixteenth hi-hats.

The arrangement opens on bells and piano, adds brass at the first title line, and thins to bells for an instrumental break.

In the mix, vocal and bells share the center while brass spreads wide.

Side-chain compression pumps the piano on each kick, and plate reverb trails the bells.

A female group vocal answers each title line in tight unison.

arms.sp_in: Korean trot-voiced acoustic ballad, 76 BPM, 4/4, G major. Warm mid-tempo semi-ballad with a gentle, hopeful glow. Male vocal in a standard range, restrained and close, with traditional phrasing, light vibrato on held line endings and pronounced slides into the high notes. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar carries the verses with soft arpeggios, a felt-touch piano adds sparse chords, and a warm saxophone answers the vocal lines as the counter-melody, stepping forward in each chorus. The acoustic bass plays a steady root note pattern under the harmony. A full kit with brushed snare and soft kick on a straight eighth-note groove, lifting gently in the choruses. Low strings swell under the second and third choruses. Clean, dry mix with the voice up front and plenty of air between phrases. Quiet guitar and saxophone duet to close, ending on a soft held chord.

arms.sp_in: Korean trot-voiced guitar pop ballad, 72 BPM, 4/4, Bb major. Male vocal, standard register, restrained and warm, traditional phrasing, light vibrato on held line endings, pronounced slides into chorus lines, every word clear. Fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar leads; accordion answers each sung phrase as a gentle countermelody and carries the instrumental breaks. Smooth bass in a soft, laid-back pocket, round sustained notes gliding root to fifth. Full kit drums kept light, rim clicks and closed hi-hat in verses, a straight eighth-note groove with warm kick and snare in choruses. Soft piano pads and a thin string bed underneath. Bridge thins to guitar and voice alone, then the band returns; the ending fades on accordion and guitar. Tender, grateful late-night mood, unhurried, dry close vocal with subtle room reverb.
